faq.q: Can I make an Instagram ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, share your idea in one sentence and choose a Reels-style clip or a square still. The credit cost shows before you start.

faq.q: Which Instagram placements can I make ads for?
faq.a: Make a 9:16 clip for Reels and Stories, or a square still to crop for the feed and carousel. Pick the file the placement asks for.

faq.q: Do I need to book a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. The clip or still is built from your own product photo, so there is no shoot day and no wait for footage. Start another job when you need a new angle.

faq.q: How do I build a carousel ad?
faq.a: Run a separate square job for each slide, such as a front view, an in-hand view and a close detail, then put the stills together as one carousel in Instagram.

faq.q: Does the file include captions and music?
faq.a: No. Add your caption, stickers and sound in Instagram, Canva or Ads Manager after download. The file itself has no text or audio.
Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product, with a little space around it. This keeps the item clear when Instagram adds controls or crops the image.
